experiment: Experiment 1: Comparative Evaluation of Unsupervised Anomaly-Detection Models

split.imputation: per-feature median fit using training rows; reused for all models; all-empty training feature falls back to 0.0

Isolation Forest.scaling: None (preserves existing backend Isolation Forest baseline)
Isolation Forest.score_definition: -decision_function(X); sklearn decision_function is larger for inliers, negated so higher means more anomalous

Local Outlier Factor.scaling: StandardScaler fit on common training split; applied to train and held-out records
Local Outlier Factor.score_definition: -score_samples(X); sklearn documents lower score_samples as more abnormal, negated so higher means more anomalous

One-Class SVM.scaling: StandardScaler fit on common training split; applied to train and held-out records
One-Class SVM.score_definition: -decision_function(X); positive decision values indicate inliers, negated so higher means more anomalous

Elliptic Envelope.scaling: StandardScaler fit on common training split; applied to train and held-out records
Elliptic Envelope.score_definition: -decision_function(X); sklearn decision values are positive for inliers, negated so higher means more anomalous

preprocessing_rationale: Isolation Forest baseline retains raw features; LOF and RBF One-Class SVM depend on distances/kernels, while Elliptic Envelope uses covariance geometry and scaling improves numerical conditioning across dollar, day, ratio, count, and text-length units.
limitations: The project has no independently verified anomaly labels; no accuracy, precision, recall, F1, confusion matrix, or ROC-AUC is reported.
Anomaly flags are statistical screening outputs, not evidence of fraud, corruption, or wrongdoing.
Contamination and nu are model threshold/settings, not accuracy measures; holdout flagged percentages can differ from them.
LOF uses novelty=True and scores only the held-out cohort; sklearn notes novelty-mode scores can differ from standard in-sample outlier-detection scores.
Isolation Forest keeps its existing estimator settings but is fit only on the common training split for this comparative experiment, not on the full dataset as in the application pipeline.
